title: PromptGuard: AI Privacy & Secret Shield
description: Real-time scanner, git pre-commit shield, .gitignore auto-protector, and copy-as-masked-prompt tool for AI assistants (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude).

title: Deep JSON
description: Color themes that give every level of JSON nesting its own color. Four Monokai variants, Jazz Solo Cup and VS Code Dark, each with vivid or muted brackets.

title: Hesperus
description: Zoomable graph of a repo's structure, calls, and data flow, built by static analysis. No model draws or guesses edges.

title: Codex notification
description: Workspace-scoped Codex alerts for unanswered questions and explicitly declared completed tasks.

title: Git Timekeeper
description: Automatic Git-based time tracking and branch analytics for developers.

title: Simple Image Gallery
description: Rich interactive visual image gallery web GUI for browsing, inspecting, and managing workspace images.

title: Lyth
description: Lyth language support: syntax highlighting, the Lyth language server (diagnostics, completion, hover with the generated Go, go to definition, references, rename, signature help, inlay hints, quick fixes), run and test buttons, snippets.
